review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this pending-decision planning case. It preserves REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003 and DEC-001, the repository identity/base commit, and the paired-case identity. The unresolved default policy is material: Gold correctly expects blocked readiness at decisions, with requirement-decision-pending for DEC-001 and repository/requirements/decisions evidence only. Conditional acceptance criteria do not authorize selecting OPT-1 or OPT-2. Empty task and assignment expectations are appropriate because this scenario must stop before producing assignable tasks; the empty team catalog does not invalidate this earlier deterministic gate. The nine binding-owner paths are supported by the supplied source: message construction, option contracts and normalization, registry filtering, forwarding/merging, public declarations and hook consumers. Existing correct forwarding and declaration consumers require inspection, not mandatory edits. Build configuration supports treating distribution declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners, and tsconfig.test.json includes the proposed test-d scope for compile-time checks. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree across repository, source, team, decision input, prompts, model, sampling, budgets and metric policy. The supplied provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation digest domains and trim-only PRD persistence. I rely on the Service's mechanical digest bindings; I did not recompute digests or execute code. The supplied isolation facts establish that this expectation precedes every candidate on this bundle; historical project operations are not candidate evidence or new human attestations. Approval is of the Gold expectation, not resolution of DEC-001, execution readiness, or task dispatch.
